title.narrative: Edu-care: inclusive actions to protect disabled children's rights

description.narrative: The Action seeks to protect the rights of children and youth with disabilities and enhance access to inclusive and special education in Lusaka and Ndola Districts. The proposed final beneficiaries are: 19,000 children and youths with disabilities (respectively 11,000 and 8000),400 families of children and youth with disabilities,89 street children at the Luigi Drop-in in Ndola.
